(i) there is a polynomial time algorithm to recognize the class of (theta, wheel, prism)-free graphs; (ii) there is a linear time algorithm to recognize a subclass of (theta, prism)-free and (theta, pyramid)-free graphs; and (iii) there is a constant-factor polynomial time approximation algorithm to find a largest clique or independent set in a (theta, prism, pyramid)-free graph.
(1) the class of theta-free graphs is a minor-closed class, and (2) the class of wheel-free graphs is a well-covered class.
